full_page.content:
1945, August 2
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten orig- inal by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
ST. MICHAEL'S MONASTERY 225 JEROME STREET BROOKLYN N. Y.
V. Brother Leo O.F.M. Cap. 1740 Mt. Elliott Ave Detroit 7, Michigan
God bless you Br. Leo - with Brother Rufin, Br. Gerard and all.
The "bottle in the corner" you asked about is water from Lourdes. Use it in case of sickness, etc. It was sent me from the Shrine directly. DO not worry about missing this or what piece of junk in Cell #5. I've often figured on how to rid myself of the whole collection.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M. Cap. L.J.
Note: Written on a picture postcard of the Famous Old Grape Vine, San Gabriel, California with notation on picture: "We were here July 11, -- waited five days for reservation."
